easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
